How to Use Kiierr Laser Hair Caps

We’ve compiled a comprehensive list for Kiierr customers to get the most out of their LLLT Hair Growth System. You will also receive this information and more included in your system. This is meant to be an additional, helpful resource for our customers.

Step 1. Unpack & connect the charger to the power pack.

Unpack all components of your new Kiierr Laser Cap system. Connect the power pack to the charger and plug into any outlet to charge fully. You need a full charge for the best results.

** Before operating, please note the following: The Kiierr Laser Hair Growth Cap should never be plugged directly into an outlet. It should only be used with the portable power pack included in your Kiierr system.

Step 2. Place the Kiierr Laser Hair Cap module into the ball cap.

Place the Kiierr Laser Hair module into the black ball cap provided or any standard ball cap of your choosing.

Step 3. Connect the USB to the power pack and the Kiierr Laser Hair Cap module.

After your power pack is fully charged, connect the USB to the power pack and the Kiierr Laser Cap module you placed inside the ball cap. Make sure the USB port is fully connected to the cap. Please do not force the USB to connect as you may have it upside down.

Step 4. Place the Kiierr Laser Hair Cap module on your head and press the on button once to turn on (the device will blink when on, then automatically turn off when 30 minutes is complete).

Place the Kiierr Laser Hair Cap on your head and press the power button. The blue battery indicator light will come, and the Kiierr laser cap will start working. Once the laser cap is powered up, you may sit and enjoy a book or TV show, or since the system is completely portable, you can take a walk or go to town.

Step 5. Wear your Kiierr Laser Cap for 30 minutes every other day to enjoy incredible results such as thicker, healthier hair.

Wear your Kiierr Laser Hair Cap for 30 minutes every other day. The cap will automatically turn itself off after 30 minutes, so you need not worry about the time.

** Before operating, please note the following: Do not look directly at the laser diodes on your Kiierr Laser Cap, as it can potentially harm your eyes. Do not turn on the cap until it is safely on your head and away from your eyes.
